_note: Starting point for the FastAPI controller described in park-library/system docs/PSBP_Mini_PC_Display_System_Deployment_Plan_UPDATED.md, section 17 ('choose what to show, then where'). This file lives in the repo so it reaches PSBP-Office and PSBP-Galleria on the normal 10-minute git pull, same as every other published JSON. The controller reads this list to build its WHAT TO SHOW buttons; each 'file' is a path relative to the repo root that the controller turns into a full localhost URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080/screens/screen-volunteer.html). Add a row here whenever a new screen is built — nothing else needs to change for the controller to offer it.
